message.content: According to the conversation recorded on 20260622_13:30, Hailey Johnson invited Li Hua to a special event at the bakery that would launch a new line of healthy bread options. The event was described as a "fun tasting session." Hailey informed Li Hua that the event would start at 10 AM on Saturday. Li Hua confirmed her attendance, stating she would be there at 10 AM to try the new healthy options. Therefore, the event at Hailey's bakery starts at 10:00 AM on Saturday.
